fusions.name: Textbook Blow
fusions.desc: A precise blow that deals 30 damage, ignores the target's resistances and is always a critical hit. It leaves the target 10% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Broken Tempo
fusions.desc: Sweeps a cone 3 tiles long that deals 7 damage to everything in it, with a 30% chance to leave each [Stalled] for 5 seconds. Holds 4 charges, and kills give charges back.

fusions.name: Settled Stance
fusions.desc: After settling for 1.5 seconds, increases your damage by 35% for 20 seconds.

fusions.name: Thousandth Repetition
fusions.desc: Every hit you land builds a stack on you, up to 5. Your next critical hit spends them all: a blow strikes the nearest enemy within 8 tiles for 34% of your weapon damage per stack. Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.
